select a.*,v.name venue_name, (select min(x.start_at) from activity_session x where x.activity_id=a.id and x.status='PUBLISHED' and x.end_at>current_timestamp) next_start_at, (select count(*) from activity_session x where x.activity_id=a.id and x.status='PUBLISHED') session_count from activity a join venue v on v.id=a.venue_id
order by a.id desc limit 20 offset #{offset}

select p.id,p.session_id,p.status,p.queue_seq,p.confirm_deadline,p.created_at, a.id activity_id,a.title,v.id venue_id,v.name venue_name,x.start_at,x.end_at,current_timestamp server_time from (select id,session_id,status,queue_seq,confirm_deadline,created_at from participation where user_id=#{user} order by id desc limit 20 offset #{offset}) p join activity_session x on x.id=p.session_id join activity a on a.id=x.activity_id join venue v on v.id=a.venue_id order by p.id desc
